Package org.jdesktop.lg3d.apps.swingnode

package org.jdesktop.lg3d.apps.swingnode
This is a simple test of the SwingNode infrastructure. The demo maps a swing panel onto a simple cloth simulation. The cloth is blowing in the wind. Even as the cloth deforms you can still interact with the JPanel components. This simply demonstrates that we can map the Swing JPanel onto an arbritrary shape, it's not meant to be a usable example.
